mapper.select: SELECT te.*, ei.item_name, sm.meeting_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_member tm WHERE tm.team_entry_id = te.team_entry_id AND tm.del_flag = 0) as current_members FROM team_entry te LEFT JOIN event_item ei ON te.item_id = ei.item_id LEFT JOIN sports_meeting sm ON te.meeting_id = sm.meeting_id WHERE te.meeting_id = #{meetingId} AND te.del_flag = 0 ORDER BY te.create_time DESC

SELECT te.*, ei.item_name, sm.meeting_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_member tm WHERE tm.team_entry_id = te.team_entry_id AND tm.del_flag = 0) as current_members FROM team_entry te LEFT JOIN event_item ei ON te.item_id = ei.item_id LEFT JOIN sports_meeting sm ON te.meeting_id = sm.meeting_id WHERE te.team_entry_id = #{teamEntryId} AND te.del_flag = 0
